WITH patient_lab AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.APTT) as aptt_avg,
    AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) as alb_minus_tp_avg
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_level AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(aptt_avg) as sex_level_aptt_avg,
    AVG(alb_minus_tp_avg) as A
  FROM patient_lab
  GROUP BY SEX
),
b_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) as B
  FROM sex_level
  WHERE A IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(sl.SEX, 'Missing') as patient_sex,
  sl.sex_level_aptt_avg,
  sl.A,
  sl.A - b.B as a_minus_b
FROM sex_level sl
CROSS JOIN b_value b
WHERE sl.A IS NOT NULL 
  AND b.B IS NOT NULL 
  AND sl.A > b.B
ORDER BY sl.SEX
